tools.name: visor_info
tools.description: Public facts about Visor, the US-only ad network and SSP for AI chat apps: what it does, ad formats, the privacy model, published results with their footnotes, and links to signup, docs, and policies. No key needed.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Lists the Visor docs pages with slug, title, group, URL, and summary. Public pages can be read with read_doc without a key. Pages marked verified only open with a verified key.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Returns one Visor docs page as Markdown, by slug from list_docs (for example 'quickstart', 'web', 'ad-formats', 'privacy'). Public pages need no key. Verified pages (sdk, api, matching, openrtb, webhooks) return their outline only with a verified key.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns your own Visor account: email, created and last-login dates, verification state, and how many MCP API keys are active. Needs an API key from a verified Visor account (Authorization: Bearer vsr_...).

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Returns the status of your own publisher application (pending, approved, or rejected) and the details you submitted. Needs an API key from a verified Visor account (Authorization: Bearer vsr_...).

tools.name: submit_support_request
tools.description: Sends a message from your verified account to the Visor team. Replies go to your account email. Up to 10 requests per hour. Needs an API key from a verified Visor account (Authorization: Bearer vsr_...).

tools.name: get_revenue_report
tools.description: Revenue, impressions, and CPM for your apps by day. Not available yet: returns a not_available error and no data. Needs an API key from a verified Visor account (Authorization: Bearer vsr_...).

tools.name: list_placements
tools.description: The ad slots configured for your apps. Not available yet: returns a not_available error and no data. Needs an API key from a verified Visor account (Authorization: Bearer vsr_...).

tools.name: get_sdk_config
tools.description: Your publisher ID and SDK settings, which come with the publisher agreement. Not available yet: returns a not_available error and no data. Needs an API key from a verified Visor account (Authorization: Bearer vsr_...).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_docs, get_account · Private data: get_account, get_application_status, submit_support_request, get_revenue_report, list_placements, get_sdk_config · Public sink: get_account, submit_support_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_docs, get_account · Private data: get_account, get_application_status, submit_support_request, get_revenue_report, list_placements, get_sdk_config · Public sink: get_account, submit_support_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
